tinker/base/main.ts.defineMain: Type only: it gives a command's main its input type and runs nothing.

tinker/base/main-host.ts.createMainHost: The host for commands with no port: it runs before any scope exists.
tinker/base/main-host.ts.runMain: The process form of that host: it owns OS signals and the exit code.

tinker/base/panics.server.ts.observeServerPanics: The process panic hook: it must report even when the root's own close fails.

tinker/base/telemetry-worker.ts.telemetryWorkerInput: The worker thread's inputs: read from workerData before its root exists.
tinker/base/telemetry-worker.ts.serveTelemetryWorker: The worker's native loop beside its root. A span here would feed the telemetry it drains.

tinker/components/telemetry/thread.serve.plain: A check inside the native observer callbacks: a span here would feed the telemetry it sends.

src/kit/app.server.ts.setup: The plugin API of Bun.build: Bun calls it while it bundles a frame, and it only gives each relative import to the localPath operation.

src/kit/easel-frame.ts.frameLogic: @easel/frame's API for frame code (SPEC-kit § App frames): a frame calls it as a plain function at module level; no easel graph runs it.
src/kit/easel-frame.ts.cn: @easel/frame's API for frame code: the cn of shadcn/ui, called in className as a plain function by frame code and the kit's pieces.
src/kit/easel-frame.ts.mount: @easel/frame's API for the composed document: its module script calls it once in the frame's iframe, before any scope exists.
src/kit/easel-frame.ts.take: A step of mount: it runs in the frame's iframe, outside easel's graph.
src/kit/easel-frame.ts.field: A step of mount: it runs in the frame's iframe, outside easel's graph.
src/kit/easel-frame.ts.hello: A step of mount: it runs in the frame's iframe, outside easel's graph.
src/kit/easel-frame.ts.refused: A step of mount: it draws a refused start in the frame's iframe, outside easel's graph.
src/kit/easel-frame.ts.values: A step of mount: it reads the look values of the frame's sheet in its iframe, outside easel's graph.
src/kit/easel-frame.ts.fieldOf: A step of mount: it reads a field of a Tinker unit in the frame's iframe, outside easel's graph.
src/kit/easel-frame.ts.offerOf: A step of mount: it lists the axes of a capsule frame in its iframe, outside easel's graph.
src/kit/easel-frame.ts.draw: A step of mount: it makes the scope of a capsule frame in its iframe; no easel graph runs it.
src/kit/easel-frame.ts.frameControls: @easel/frame's API for frame code (SPEC-kit § The capsules, "The controls in the viewer"): a frame calls it as a plain function at module level; no easel graph runs it.
src/kit/easel-frame.ts.controlsOf: A step of mount: it lists the controls that the panel can draw, in the frame's iframe, outside easel's graph.
src/kit/easel-frame.ts.told: A step of mount: it posts the values of the controls on the port, in the frame's iframe, outside easel's graph.
src/kit/easel-frame.ts.watch: A step of mount: it watches the value cells of the scope on screen, in the frame's iframe, outside easel's graph.
src/kit/easel-frame.ts.runControl: A step of mount: it runs a control's operation in the scope on screen, in the frame's iframe, outside easel's graph.
src/kit/easel-frame.ts.framePart: @easel/frame's API for frame code (SPEC-kit § The capsules, "A control in its own scope"): a frame calls it as a plain function at module level; no easel graph runs it.
src/kit/easel-frame.ts.framePanes: @easel/frame's API for frame code (SPEC-kit § The capsules, "A control in its own scope"): a frame calls it as a plain function at module level; no easel graph runs it.
src/kit/easel-frame.ts.axesNow: A step of mount: it reads the axes and the kit CSS of the document in the frame's iframe, outside easel's graph.
src/kit/easel-frame.ts.mountPane: A step of mount: it mounts a pane in its own iframe, before any scope exists; no easel graph runs it.
src/kit/easel-frame.ts.link: A step of mount: it gives a pane a new pane link of the scope on screen, in the frame's iframe, outside easel's graph.
src/kit/easel-frame.ts.unlink: A step of mount: it ends the pane links of the scope on screen, in the frame's iframe, outside easel's graph.
src/kit/easel-frame.ts.size: A step of mountPane: it posts the size of the pane's content from a ResizeObserver callback, outside easel's graph.
src/kit/easel-frame.ts.frameMatrix: @easel/frame's API for frame code (SPEC-pieces rule 16): a frame calls it as a plain function at module level; no easel graph runs it.
src/kit/easel-frame.ts.tagValues: A step of mount: it reads the values of a tag from its parse in the frame's iframe, outside easel's graph.
src/kit/easel-frame.ts.matrixPicks: A step of mount: it lists the cells of a matrix, one for each value of its switches, in the frame's iframe, outside easel's graph.
src/kit/easel-frame.ts.drawScope: A step of draw: it makes the scope of a capsule frame for one set of axes in its iframe; no easel graph runs it.
src/kit/easel-frame.ts.drawCell: A step of drawMatrix: it draws one cell of a matrix in its own scope, in the frame's iframe, outside easel's graph.
src/kit/easel-frame.ts.drawMatrix: A step of draw: it draws each cell of a matrix side by side in the frame's iframe; no easel graph runs it.
src/kit/easel-frame.ts.showKit: A step of take: it writes a kit message into the sheets and the data of the document in the frame's iframe, outside easel's graph.
src/kit/easel-frame.ts.fixtureNamesOf: A step of mount: it lists the fixture names of the frame's fixture cells in its iframe, outside easel's graph.
src/kit/easel-frame.ts.fixtureValue: A step of mount: it parses a fixture with the parse of its cell in the frame's iframe, outside easel's graph.
src/kit/easel-frame.ts.setFixtures: A step of draw: it sets the fixture of the axes in the cells of the new scope, in the frame's iframe, outside easel's graph.

src/kit/port-link.ts.reply: A step of the port's message listener (a MessagePort callback, outside any run): it gives a reply to the call that waits for it.
src/kit/port-link.ts.push: A step of the port's message listener (a MessagePort callback, outside any run): it gives a push to its watch.
src/kit/port-link.ts.end: A step of the port's message listener (a MessagePort callback, outside any run): it ends a watch.
src/kit/port-link.ts.answer: A step of the server capsule's run hook, as in Tinker's memory backend: the protocol must get the hook's own run, which no operation has.
src/kit/port-link.ts.stream: A step of the server capsule's run hook, as in Tinker's memory backend: the protocol must get the hook's own run, which no operation has.
src/kit/port-link.ts.listen: A step of the server capsule's run hook: it serves a MessagePort, whose listener runs outside any run; each message opens its own session of the accept.
src/kit/port-link.ts.session: A step of the server capsule's run hook: it serves a MessagePort, whose listener runs outside any run; each message opens its own session of the accept.
src/kit/port-link.ts.onCall: A step of the server capsule's run hook: it serves a MessagePort, whose listener runs outside any run; each message opens its own session of the accept.
src/kit/port-link.ts.onOpen: A step of the server capsule's run hook: it serves a MessagePort, whose listener runs outside any run; each message opens its own session of the accept.
src/kit/port-link.ts.take: The port's message listener (a MessagePort callback, outside any run), on the client and on the server: it routes each message by its type.
src/kit/port-link.ts.gone: A step of the port's message listener (a MessagePort callback, outside any run), and of the client's close: it ends each call and watch on the way as a link fault.

src/build/binary.server.ts.setup: The plugin API of Bun.build: Bun calls it while it compiles the binary, and it only gives each loaded file to the oxcBindings, oxcVisitor and runtime steps.

src/map/shots.server.ts.setup: The plugin API of Bun.build: Bun calls it while it bundles the page and the walk of a map, and it only gives the units module, the fonts and the view to their steps (pressMarks).
